Project Work: Group Model Creation of Cell Division Stages Materials Required: − Woolen thread − Thermocol (Polystyrene) − Chart paper − Glue − Color pencils − Instructions:

Procedure: i. Divide the students into small groups, ensuring each group has access to the required materials. ii. Assign each group the task of creating a model depicting different stages of cell division using woolen thread on the provided chart paper. iii. Encourage collaboration within each group, as students use glue to secure the woolen thread on the chart paper and color pencils to label the stages. iv. Instruct groups to prepare a brief presentation explaining their model, focusing on the labeled components and stages of cell division. v. Facilitate a class session where each group presents their model to their classmates. Emphasize clarity and understanding during presentations. vi. Display all completed models on the classroom board. Engage the class in a discussion about the various approaches and details presented in each group's model.
